# Which Cabin

> Which Cabin (whichcabin.com) tells cruise passengers which cabin and deck to book, and which to avoid, on 25 of the biggest cruise ships. Each ship page has a deck noise map built from the current deck plan, quiet decks, seasickness picks and cited sources. Checked 15 Nov 2026.

Independent; not affiliated with any cruise line. Layouts change; confirm on the line's deck plan.

## Guides
- [How to choose a cruise cabin](https://whichcabin.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-cruise-cabin/)
- [Quietest cabin decks on every ship](https://whichcabin.com/guides/quietest-cruise-cabins/)
- [Best cabin for seasickness](https://whichcabin.com/guides/best-cabin-for-seasickness/)
- [Cruise cabins to avoid](https://whichcabin.com/guides/cruise-cabins-to-avoid/)
- [Sources and methods](https://whichcabin.com/methodology/)
